violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: observed dishwashing with a sanitizing rinse concentration of less 100ppm of quaternary ammonia.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. Please contact a technician to repair sanitizer dispenser so it can provide the appropriate concentration of quaternary ammonia prior the follow up inspection.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: Time as a Public Health Control, Written Procedures
violations.observation: The person in charge is not able to provide written procedures for the use of time as a public health control with the following time/temperature control for safety food item(s): Milk in carafe.
violations.corrective_action: If time only is used as a public health control for a working supply of time/temperature control for safety food before cooking or for ready to eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that is displayed or held for service for immediate consumption, written procedures shall be prepared in advance and maintained in the food establishment and made available to the regulatory authority upon request. PIC agreed to sign and follow the procedure for using Time as a Public Health Control for milk.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: Observed no test strips for quaternary ammonia located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solutions.
violations.corrective_action: Please obtain a quaternary ammonia test kit prior the follow up inspection.
